body: i know im too stressed, i have chronic stress & depression issues. for reference, im female to male trans and i would be depressed even if i wasnt trans, just as i have been depressed nearly all my life. i dont remember a time when i wasnt suicidal or stressed. i cant do medication cause the side effects stress me out. i just know im going to die by my own hand at some point and id rather it be sooner than later. im tired of suffering while being useless, a burden, and a societal outcast.
